name: Gmail AI Labeler
description: Poll incoming Gmail messages, classify each body into existing Inquiry, Partnership and Notification labels, and add each message’s own label IDs.
requirements: One Gmail mailbox with message-read, label-read and message-modify access selected consistently on the poll, reads and writes
Existing Gmail labels named Inquiry, Partnership and Notification
Configured gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 model service; OpenAI shutdown January 14, 2027, then choose and recheck an available model in both formats
Open Flow bundle import; publish Gmail Label Classifier and refresh its interface in Gmail AI Labeler before enabling the poll
One-minute poll enabled with an explicit 25-message budget; monitor failures and backlog

source.path: Gmail_and_Email_Automation/Auto-label incoming Gmail messages with AI nodes.json
